name: qwen3-split-attention
note: Second assembly (S6 gate 5): every layer's attention split into two attention paths (query heads 0 to 7 with key-value heads 0 to 3, and 8 to 15 with 4 to 7), each binding only its half's clusters, their outputs added before one shared SwiGLU that binds the same feed-forward clusters as the reference. Mathematically the reference (the output projection is linear over heads); checked by the port check and a Step Check against the reference. Written by `nano-lab run s6 assemblies`; do not edit by hand.
